newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Oklahoma feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was inactive in the panhandle late Monday. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested at the close.

Feedlots reported light inquiry from buyers. 11,800 head confirmed for the week to date. The last established price was 67.00 on Friday. Today's packer bids are 66.00-67.00 with asking prices 68.00-69.00.
Confirmed: None Week Ago: None Year Ago: 200
Wk to date: 11,800 Week Ago: 21,800 Year Ago: 13,500
